scope: Real production modules with failure-injected in-memory Web Storage; not browser storage or native qualification.

checks.name: Structured save survives a fresh load with checksum verification
Verified commit remains successful when temporary cleanup is denied
Valid primary load does not become corruption when cleanup is denied
Editing and snapshotting a selected non-default slot preserves its identity
Custom serializer round-trip retains its namespace through normalization
Interrupted primary write preserves the previous slot and supports explicit recovery
Corrupt primary recovers the prior committed backup explicitly
Successful commit invalidates a previously offered recovery candidate
Ordered schema migration renames and supplies defaults on load
Cancelled async save writes no persistent keys and releases busy state
